purpose: Behavioral evaluation prompts; not automatically executed by the package checker.

cases.prompt: Design a public marketing landing page with expressive animation.
expected: Recognize this is outside admin-ux-design scope; do not force admin patterns.
must_not: Generate an admin table or load all admin patterns.

cases.prompt: An approved admin screen has a bottom floating batch bar. Improve selection clarity.
expected: Preserve bar location.
Specify count/scope and check obstruction/focus.
must_not: Move the bar to the top solely because Carbon does so.

cases.prompt: Only a business flow and a disposable HTML demo exist. Implement the React page.
expected: Read real project contracts and identify missing API/data design.
Treat prototype internals as non-authoritative; defer affected integration.
must_not: Convert the demo array shape into an API contract.

cases.prompt: The save API contract is approved; backend implementation is pending.
expected: Allow formal frontend development with contract-conforming isolated mocks.
Do not silently fall back to mocks in production.
must_not: Block all frontend work merely because data is mocked.

cases.prompt: A two-field edit requires document comparison and a long calculation.
expected: Choose the container from task complexity and context.
Do not use a numeric field-count rule.
must_not: Always choose a drawer because there are fewer than seven fields.

cases.prompt: Add bulk edit; selected records have mixed values and mixed eligibility.
expected: Separate keep/set/clear intent.
Surface unresolved eligibility and result semantics as material questions.
must_not: Silently skip ineligible records or invent partial success.

cases.prompt: Approved prototype returns to a filtered list; the written contract says reset all filters.
expected: Surface and reconcile conflicting approved artifacts before affected coding.
must_not: Assume prose or prototype code automatically wins.

cases.prompt: A user approved the save-success demo; failure and permission behavior were hidden.
expected: Record only actually approved scope.
Expose consequential undisclosed decisions without claiming full approval.

cases.prompt: An approved admin table truncates a known field incorrectly; the correct behavior is already specified.
expected: Apply the bounded change using existing conventions and focused acceptance.
must_not: Require a new business YAML, CRUD framework, prototype, UX freeze, or audit phase.

cases.prompt: A submit request times out after the server may have committed.
expected: Do not claim rollback or success.
Use or request the actual reconciliation path before repeat writes.
must_not: Enable blind retry or show an invented undo action.

cases.prompt: A reference recommends undo, but this product contract forbids recovery of a deletion.
expected: Keep the approved business meaning; choose an appropriate consequential-action safeguard.
must_not: Add undo solely to satisfy a general heuristic.

cases.prompt: UX prototype is approved, but permissions and module ownership have not been designed.
expected: Pass the approved UX through existing Technical Design.
Keep server enforcement and engineering verification responsibilities intact.
must_not: Claim the UX Skill guarantees production code quality.
